rows.group: Task: L, obligation, principal, result, T · §2.1
rows.bounded_coverage: Lengths 2, 3 and 4; fixed task and complete routes in the graph.
rows.remaining_obligation: Individual mandate record; functional unit for L; verifiable deadline and delivery. Do not assume a legitimate solution in every historical task.

rows.bounded_coverage: N=1,2,4 in a separate query-allocation module; cost and rounds distinguished.
rows.remaining_obligation: Decision-making population, unequal capability, network, arrivals and departures, schedule and resources per receiver. This module does not execute agents.

rows.bounded_coverage: Four fixed mean profiles; deterministic grid, without world rejection.
rows.remaining_obligation: Probabilistic generative family, normalization and comparable selection; not calibrated with HF data.

rows.group: Realized attractiveness of I and P · §2.1
rows.bounded_coverage: Verdicts and J of all routes; exact optimum including mixtures.
rows.remaining_obligation: Distinguish agent expectation, evaluator score and legitimate quality. Do not attribute synthetic values 1–4 to the incident.

rows.bounded_coverage: Preserved mean, centered deviations and half-range σ; σ=0 or 1/4.
rows.remaining_obligation: Random distribution, more general correlations and causal effect on choice. SC-Ha and monotonicity are not proved.

rows.group: Geometry, D, τ, sides and connections · §2.4
rows.bounded_coverage: Synthetic coordinates; τ=0 or 1/2, positive/negative alignment with benefits; explicit connectors.
rows.remaining_obligation: Historical functional geometry, both sides and displacement of current position. D is fixed per chain, not swept as an independent parameter.

rows.bounded_coverage: The radius filter from a fixed origin is preserved for each route.
rows.remaining_obligation: Costly search policy, sequential discovery, memory and radius from changing positions. The auditor's complete map is not attributed to the agent.

rows.bounded_coverage: Conjunction and algebraic parity control, separately; connector conditions; valid routes.
rows.remaining_obligation: Identifiable historical predicate. Parity is not real permission semantics. The query block uses one uniform witness and is not confused with the entire graph grid.

rows.group: Review: k_a, k_d, order, exit and reuse · §2.8
rows.bounded_coverage: Clipped windows with unique coverage; exact early-exit cost under a uniform witness; adaptive queries in the submodel.
rows.remaining_obligation: Complete historical review policy and its relation to selection, waiting, rejection and budget. Windows are not integrated into a social campaign.

rows.group: Costs: c_e, c_v, ρ and other charges · §2.11
rows.bounded_coverage: Cost identities of explicit strategies; allocation module with c_e=2, c_v=1 and accounted communication.
rows.remaining_obligation: Unit calibration; complete exploration, discard, execution and maintenance ledger. Formulas are not universal bounds.

rows.group: Resources: R, T, v, beta and transfers · §2.12
rows.bounded_coverage: Residual query budget; global budget versus per-agent budget; query rounds.
rows.remaining_obligation: v/beta allocation, execution reserve, full latency, expiry and transfer policy. The complete scheduler is not simulated.

rows.group: Network: topology, s, latency, w_s and dependency · §2.10
rows.bounded_coverage: Copies of the same root add no coverage.
rows.remaining_obligation: Emission and reception dynamics, causal influence, comparable degree, congestion and individual sequence. Counting copies does not model w_s.

rows.group: Policy: selection, tie-breaking, waiting and recovery · §2.15
rows.bounded_coverage: All adaptive policies of the small query contract through dynamic programming.
rows.remaining_obligation: Complete CV-C1/CV-A1/CV-A2/CV-EA; abstention, return connectors and post-effect recovery. The submodel is not the entire R01 family.

rows.bounded_coverage: Unique coverage and relays; charges of enumerated strategies.
rows.remaining_obligation: Emergent Q from search and selection, reviewed-proposal rate r_inv and their coupling. Q is not equated with N.

rows.bounded_coverage: Deterministic static grid; two identifier permutations; rejection of inapplicable version.
rows.remaining_obligation: Held-out worlds, agent random streams and temporal campaign. Checking an incorrect version measures neither expiry nor SC-He.

rows.bounded_coverage: Exact Adm/J and exact submodel probabilities; bounded-module costs.
rows.remaining_obligation: Complete per-campaign vector, censoring, uncertainty, Pareto and statistical comparison. No empirical effectiveness map exists.

rows.bounded_coverage: Their premises are audited and controls that may resolve the case are preserved.
rows.remaining_obligation: Their own execution and inference. They are not theorems established by the base scenario.

rows.bounded_coverage: Only its accounting role is reviewed; EA is not executed.
rows.remaining_obligation: Costs of preparing, applying and maintaining evidence; comparison with conventional certificates and cache. No observed saving is attributed to EA here.

scope_note: This is a manually grounded audit register, not a machine certification of the historical incident.
